items.title: A Shared ChatGPT Link Could Run Attacker Code in Your Session and Read Private Chats

items.title: Can FrodoKEM Run in a Millisecond? FPGA Says Yes!
items.summary: FrodoKEM is a post-quantum key encapsulation mechanism based on plain Learning With Errors (LWE). In contrast to module-lattice-based schemes, it relies on an unstructured variant of the LWE problem, providing more conservative and better-understood security guarantees. In this paper, we explore hardware-level parallelization of FrodoKEM's matrix multiplication, which dominates its execution time.
